UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public dating profile for a registered user without PII, including 6-day streak tracking, hourly GPS location updates, UPI payment verification state, and admin role.

birthDate.description: Internal date string in YYYY-MM-DD format.

interests.description: List of up to 10 interest tags.

photoBase64.description: Compressed main profile DP image as Base64.

galleryPhotos.description: Up to 6 additional profile gallery photos as compressed Base64 strings.

isProfileVerified.description: Whether the user's profile and live face video have been verified by Admin (Blue Tick).

verificationStatus.description: Status of live face video profile verification.

verificationVideoFrames.description: Recorded left-to-right live face video frames in Base64 for Admin verification.

verificationSubmittedAt.description: Epoch millis when the user submitted their live face verification video.

isPremium.description: Whether user has an active Milan Premium subscription.

premiumExpiresAt.description: Epoch millis when premium expires (0 for none).

lastPaymentAmountInr.description: Amount paid in INR for the most recent UPI subscription.

lastPaymentDateMs.description: Epoch millis of the most recent UPI subscription payment.

lastUpiTxnId.description: 12-digit UPI UTR / Transaction Reference ID for payment verification.

paymentStatus.description: Verification status of the latest UPI payment.

pendingPlan.description: Plan requested in a pending UPI verification (Monthly or Yearly).

dailyRandomFindCount.description: Number of Random Chat partners matched today (for Free daily 2-find limit).

lastRandomFindDate.description: Date string YYYY-MM-DD when dailyRandomFindCount was last updated.

streakDays.description: Consecutive days with >=15 minutes app usage (0-6).

todayUsageSeconds.description: Active app usage seconds on lastUsageDate.

lastUsageDate.description: Date string YYYY-MM-DD of last tracked usage.

lastStreakCompletedDate.description: Date string YYYY-MM-DD when 15-min goal was last completed.

allowRandomMeet.description: Whether user accepts incoming Random Chat matches even when browsing or offline.

lastActiveAtMs.description: Epoch millis of last foreground heartbeat or offline transition.

Like.title: Like
Like.description: One-way like sent from one user to another, unlocking messaging for non-premium users.

fromUserId.description: UID of user sending the like.

toUserId.description: UID of user receiving the like.

Block.title: Block
Block.description: Record of a user blocking another user.

userId.description: UID of the user who initiated the block.

blockedUserName.description: Display name of the blocked user.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Direct chat message, shared photo, or audio/video call log between two users.

photoBase64.description: Optional compressed Base64 photo shared in chat.

messageType.description: Type of chat message or call event.

CallStream.title: CallStream
CallStream.description: Real-time audio PCM and compressed JPEG video frame relay stream for active calls.

userId.description: UID of the user broadcasting their media packet.

partnerId.description: UID of the call partner receiving the media packet.

isActive.description: Whether the stream is currently active.

videoFrameBase64.description: Optional compressed JPEG camera frame in Base64.

audioChunkBase64.description: Optional 8kHz 16-bit mono PCM audio chunk in Base64.

RandomChatQueue.title: RandomChatQueue
RandomChatQueue.description: Live matchmaking queue entry for Random Chat filtered by gender, age range, and distance.

preferredMaxDistanceKm.description: Maximum preferred partner distance in km (up to 25000 for global unlimited).

matchedSessionId.description: Created RandomChatSession ID once matched (empty while waiting).

matchedPartnerId.description: Matched partner UID once matched (empty while waiting).

RandomChatSession.title: RandomChatSession
RandomChatSession.description: Shared anonymous Random Chat session with step-by-step mutual consent reveal flags.

userAGender.description: Gender of User A shown initially.

userBGender.description: Gender of User B shown initially.

endedByUserId.description: UID of participant who ended the session (empty while active).

userAConsentName.description: User A consent for Step 1 Name reveal.

userBConsentName.description: User B consent for Step 1 Name reveal.

userAConsentAge.description: User A consent for Step 2 Age reveal.

userBConsentAge.description: User B consent for Step 2 Age reveal.

userAConsentPhoto.description: User A consent for Step 3 Face/Photo reveal.

userBConsentPhoto.description: User B consent for Step 3 Face/Photo reveal.

userAConsentProfile.description: User A consent for Step 4 Full Profile reveal.

userBConsentProfile.description: User B consent for Step 4 Full Profile reveal.

RandomChatMessage.title: RandomChatMessage
RandomChatMessage.description: Unlimited real-time anonymous Random Chat messages scoped to a RandomChatSession.

participantIds.description: Two-element participant UID list copied from session.

/profiles/{profileId}.description: Public dating profiles indexed by user UID.

/messages/{messageId}.description: Real-time chat messages, photo attachments, and call logs between users.

/call_streams/{streamUserId}.description: Live two-way audio and video frame packets during an active call.

/random_chat_queue/{userId}.description: Active Random Chat matchmaking queue entries keyed by user UID.

/random_chat_sessions/{sessionId}.description: Matched anonymous Random Chat sessions with step-by-step mutual reveal state.

/random_chat_messages/{messageId}.description: Unlimited real-time messages inside Random Chat sessions.
